tank.desc: Soviet tank IS-3, a museum exhibit in the park of the city of Izhevsk. The IS-3 (also known as Object 703) is a Soviet heavy tank developed in late 1944. Its semi-hemispherical cast turret (resembling that of an upturned soup bowl) became the hallmark of post-war Soviet tanks. Its pike nose design would also be mirrored by other tanks of the IS tank family such as the IS-7 and T-10. Too late to see combat in World War II, the IS-3 participated in the Berlin Victory Parade of 1945, the Korean War, in the border conflict during the Sino-Soviet split, the Soviet invasion of Hungary.
On February 24, 2022, the Russian Federation crossed the border of Ukraine. On this day, a full-scale war began. Before you is a photo of the destroyed oneRussian tank.Good must overcome evil!

In the early 2000s in Spain, Barcelona has managed to establish itself as a reference for skateboarding worldwide, surpassing legendary cities like San Francisco or New York ...

A pleasant climate all year long, the sea near the city center, cheap life and a more permissive society have pushed many American and European professionals to spend 6 months per year, or even to move there. For a skateboarder, Barcelona finally looks more like a kind of Disneyland, with a number of spots per square kilometer, perfect and natural, completely disproportionate.

vhs.alt: Lake with anchored boats, a swan, and distant city
vhs.desc: A glorious summer day on Lake Zurich, captured on film in the early 1980s. Dozens of sailboats and small motorboats sit peacefully at their moorings, their tall masts piercing a cloudless blue sky. A lone swan glides serenely across the foreground, while a weeping willow dips its branches toward the water on the right. Across the lake, the elegant 19th-century waterfront buildings of Zurich's eastern shore stretch along the tree-lined promenade, with the gentle green hills of the Swiss Mittelland rising behind them. The film, has slightly faded tones.
